description: Return 787daily articles that mention a specific Puerto Rico town, newest first. Accepts canonical names and common variants (e.g. 'San Juan', 'Ponce', 'Rincón'). Returns { name, count (every match), returned, articles[] (at most limit, default 20), moreAt (the town's page) }, plus a note when nothing matched.

limit.description: How many articles to return, newest first (default 20)

since.description: Only articles published that day or later, YYYY-MM-DD

name: get_by_municipality
title: News about a town
